card.name: Inside brand and proper names
card.fires_on: The second piece of a name that is split into parts, such as the 'in' of Quin- or the 'Y' of VY- in a brand name, right after a CONTRAINDICATIONS heading. It also fires on a few split proper names and French phrases in general text.

modes.label: Brand names after CONTRAINDICATIONS
modes.description: A drug brand or drug name split partway through, at the start of a contraindications section.

modes.label: Split personal names
modes.description: A person's name or foreign phrase broken partway through in general text.
